obsolescence_risks: GRADER LEG MISSING (S6-B2612a, PROPOSED-NOT-BUILT): scripts/grade_institutional_config.py:20 counts the holdout (holdout_n) but never grades it, so the landing battery would write a Step-1-shaped grid with NO gate verdicts for a Step-2 cube. The engine run and the grader fix are independent; the cube must not be graded on the holdout until the grader leg ships with its pin test. If the owner declines the grader change this cube has no admission path and must not be launched.

WALL-CLOCK: the smc Step-2 cube of the same shape measured 59993 s (16.7 h) over 4 legs at 6 workers (output_audit/b2399_step2_sw50sp50_wave_summary.json). icg costs more per ticker-day than smc: the cfg1 rerun runs 200 tickers at 4 workers at ~52 s/sim-day (run_heartbeat.json 44 days / 0.6419 h). Scaled to 544 tickers: 39.6 h unscaled at the canonical 0.2613 s/ticker-day (run_wave.py:60, which the rerun heartbeat reproduces), ~16 h only if 10-worker scaling were linear (UNVERIFIED) - a 16-40 h band over 1004 sim-days. DERIVED, not measured; the first leg's measured_rates line is the number that replaces it. Each leg is capped at 4.5 h under the owner's 5 h local rule; max_legs 10 covers the worst case (6 legs).

BOUNDARY CARRIES: every leg boundary is a resume; under the pre-fix engine b2399's three boundaries dropped 35 + 83 + 39 open trades (MEASURED, its wave summary boundary_drops) and 214 of 437 of its closed trades carry signals_at_entry={} (MEASURED, S6-B2605b) - attributed to the S6-B2512 resume-boundary class (DERIVED: cfg1's 23 empties were exactly the trades closed before its one boundary). The S6-B2512 fix (closed_trade_rows single checkpoint writer) is what must hold across 4-6 boundaries here; the cfg1 rerun's first checkpoint (8 closed / 0 empty at sim-day 27 vs the original's 8 / 8) is the only in-flight evidence so far. The landing battery's replay_atr_proxy lens reports the measured rate; above REPLAY_ATR_FALLBACK_WARN_RATE the verdict is NOT COMPARABLE and this shot is void, not re-rolled.

TABLE C INGESTION (S6-B2612e): scripts/show_table_c.py GRID_GLOB output_*_grid_auto.json already renders the b2399 Step-2 cube beside the 200x1y Step-1 configs with no window/universe column; this cube's artifact will be ingested the same way and is distinguishable only by the 'step2' in its name.
